independent_counts.method: independent raw-data recount with prompt-derived gold
notes: All planned offers remain in denominators.
Quantiles are nearest-rank arrival-to-event latencies among validated API completions.
Cell quantiles pool two repetitions descriptively; no independence or population CI is asserted.
Missing REQUESTS files alone do not distinguish unoffered work from lost captures; inspect collector abort metadata for that distinction.
This recount does not replace metadata/provenance validity checks or the finite-window screen.

capture_errors: captured ID sequence differs from planned sequence
captured ID sequence differs from planned sequence
captured ID sequence differs from planned sequence

limitations: Segments are one prospectively completed study, not additional independent repetitions.
No repeated, overlapping, skipped, or selectively substituted window is accepted.
Partial suffixes remain missing and cannot constitute a completed study.
Energy uses each segment separately and retains original validity/coverage assumptions.
Serving validity and energy validity remain distinct.
File identity and recorded chronology alone do not prove prospective amendment creation.
Existing single-device, finite-window, observational and no-causal-energy limits remain.
Two matched repetitions per rate; requests are not independent replications.
Finite-window acceptance does not establish steady-state capacity, a production SLA, or a causal effect.
API completion and task-quality completion are reported separately.
All planned offers remain denominators; missing captures are unverified, not invented server failures.
Client unfinished-count proxy includes service and is not server queue length; unverified records give an upper proxy, separately flagged from known dispatched unfinished jobs.
Quantiles condition on validated API completion; first content is not instrumented TTFT.
Energy bounds use uncertain sample edges without fixed-power interpolation, baseline subtraction, or per-request allocation.
Energy is gross CPU/GPU/ANE domain telemetry, not process-attributed or whole-machine energy.
